{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print('Number of unique patients:', trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total number of rows:', len(trial_df))

# Check the maximum sample_seq per patient
max_sample_seq = trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print('\nMax sample_seq per patient:', max_sample_seq.value_counts().to_dict())

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify that each patient now appears only once
print('\nAfter deduplication: Number of unique patients:', trial_df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total number of rows after deduplication:', len(trial_df))"}
